title: G2 2024 survey of 1,940 B2B decision-makers on review sites
statement:
G2's 2024 survey of 1,940 B2B decision-makers found that public product-review websites were the most consulted information source for 31% of buyers and that independent review sites were considered more valuable than analyst firms across every reported buying stage, supporting third-party peer evidence alongside vendor claims. (Sell G2)

Options:
- Review excerpt: third_party_review_snippet_with_source_link (fits: peer led, credible)
- Review rating: aggregate_review_rating_with_source_link (fits: efficient, evidence led)
- Peer community quote: independent_community_quote_with_role (fits: human, community led)
- Verified reviewer: verified_reviewer_profile (fits: expert, transparent)
appliesWhen: Applies to: b2b saas, enterprise software. Audience: b2b buyers.
